# FiHaven — full reference

> A focused bill and debt dashboard for web, iPhone, iPad, and Android. Track
> bills, credit cards, loans, budgets, and payoff plans in one calm view, synced
> across every platform. Free to use by hand; an optional Pro subscription adds
> automation.

Canonical site: https://fihaven.app/
Last updated: 2026-08-08

---

## What FiHaven is

FiHaven is a personal bill and debt tracking application. It is aimed at people
who want a single, quiet place to see what is due, what is owed, and what the
month looks like — without the noise of a full personal-finance suite.

The design premise is that the app should be useful with zero integrations. Every
feature works with manually entered data. Bank linking exists, but it is optional,
off by default, and additive: imported transactions never overwrite manual
entries.

FiHaven is built and run by a single independent developer. It is funded entirely
by optional Pro subscriptions. There are no ads and no sale of user data to
brokers.

## Platform availability

- **Web** — live at https://fihaven.app/. The full app.
- **iPhone / iPad** — live on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fihaven/id6781084347
- **Android** — live on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.fihaven

All platforms use the same account and the same API, and data syncs between them.

## Offline behavior

FiHaven works offline on web, iPhone, iPad, and Android. Each platform keeps a
local copy of the data, so the app opens and remains usable without a connection.
Changes made offline are written to the device before anything is sent to the
server, survive closing or force-quitting the app, and sync automatically once
connectivity returns.

## Feature list

### Included free

- Unlimited bills, credit cards, and loans
- Dashboard with the current month's picture
- Budget and runway view
- Manual spending log
- Savings goals
- Net worth tracking
- Income sources and rolling pay periods
- Bill schedules from weekly through annual, with active date windows
- Mark paid, record partial payments, and skip a single month
- Archiving: keeps an item and its payment history but removes it from active
  lists, totals, reminders, emails, debt figures, and auto-marking
- Sync across web, iPhone, iPad, and Android
- JSON and CSV export
- Full account deletion
- Joining a Family household by invite (members never need their own plan)

### Added by Pro

- Payoff planner with snowball, avalanche, and minimum-payment strategies
- Calendar view and a private iCal feed
- Full payment history
- Subscription finder
- Rewards optimizer, including card perks and offers
- Category budgets
- Optional bank linking via Plaid, on both web and native
- Autopay auto-mark on due dates

### Added by Family

- Every Pro feature for the subscriber
- A household of up to three people
- Shared bills, cards, and savings goals across the household
- Household members join free and never need their own subscription
- If the Family plan lapses, shared data becomes read-only rather than being
  deleted

## Pricing

| Plan | Web | iOS / Android | Trial |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 forever | $0 forever | n/a |
| Pro monthly | $1.99 / month | $1.99 / month | 7-day free trial |
| Pro yearly | $14.99 / year | $16.99 / year | 7-day free trial |
| Family yearly | $25.99 / year | $29.99 / year | none — bills immediately |

Yearly prices are lower on the web because the app stores take a cut of in-app
purchases. No credit card is required to create a free account, and there is no
trial clock on the Free tier. Pro and Family can be cancelled at any time.

One subscription covers every platform.

## Security posture

- **Passwords** — hashed with bcrypt, never stored in plain text.
- **Sessions** — HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies with per-session CSRF tokens.
  Changing a password signs out every other device.
- **Multi-factor** — optional TOTP authenticator apps, email one-time codes, or
  WebAuthn passkeys. MFA secrets are encrypted at rest.
- **Social sign-in** — Sign in with Apple and Google are supported. If MFA is
  enabled, the second factor still runs after social sign-in.
- **Transport** — all traffic served over HTTPS.
- **Encryption at rest** — synced app data, Plaid access tokens, and MFA material
  are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Secrets live in environment configuration, not
  source control.
- **Vulnerability reports** — security@fihaven.app

Full detail: https://fihaven.app/security

## Data practices

- No advertising.
- No sale of personal data to data brokers.
- Revenue comes only from optional Pro and Family subscriptions.
- Bank linking is optional; the app is fully usable without it.
- Users can export their data as JSON or CSV at any time.
- Users can permanently delete their account and data.

Full detail: https://fihaven.app/privacy

## Common questions

**Do I need to link my bank?**
No. FiHaven works fully by hand. Bank linking through Plaid is an optional Pro
feature, and imported transactions never overwrite manual entries.

**What is included for free?**
Unlimited bills, cards, and loans; dashboard; budget; manual spending log;
savings goals; net worth; export; and full account deletion.

**What does Pro add?**
Payoff planner, calendar and iCal feed, payment history, rewards optimizer,
subscription finder, category budgets, optional Plaid bank linking, and autopay
auto-mark on due dates.

**Are the iPhone and Android apps available?**
Yes. Both are live in the public stores — iPhone and iPad on the App Store
(https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fihaven/id6781084347), Android on Google Play
(https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.fihaven).

**How does Family sharing work?**
The Family plan creates a household of up to three people who share bills, cards,
and savings goals. Joining is free — members never need their own subscription.
If the plan lapses, shared data becomes read-only rather than disappearing.

**What happens when I archive a bill or card?**
Archiving keeps the item and its payment history but takes it out of active use.
It disappears from lists and totals, stops producing reminders and emails, and is
no longer counted as debt or auto-marked paid.

**Does FiHaven work offline?**
Yes, on every platform. See "Offline behavior" above.

**Do you sell my data or show ads?**
No ads and no data brokerage. FiHaven is funded by optional Pro subscriptions.

## Contact

FiHaven is built and operated by Greigh Studios LLC, a one-person studio.

- Product, onboarding, promo codes, and billing: support@fihaven.app
- Trouble installing or signing in to the iOS or Android app: daniel@fihaven.app
- Privacy, data export or deletion, GDPR/CCPA access requests: security@fihaven.app
- Security and vulnerability reports: security@fihaven.app, or a private advisory
  at https://github.com/Greigh/FiHaven/security/advisories/new (preferred)
- Bugs and feature requests: https://github.com/Greigh/FiHaven/issues

Many common tasks need no email at all — exporting data as JSON or CSV,
disconnecting Plaid, managing a Pro subscription, changing password or MFA, and
deleting an account are all self-service in Settings.
